en.name: XML Formatter
en.short: Format, minify and validate XML, with the error located.
en.title: XML formatter and validator online
en.description: Format (pretty-print), minify and validate XML online. Errors are reported with their line and column. Comments, CDATA sections and processing instructions are kept. Works with SOAP, SVG, RSS, WSDL and any XML. 100% in your browser.
en.lead: Paste an XML document on one line and get it indented, or find where it is broken.

es.lead: Pega un documento XML en una línea y obtenlo indentado, o encuentra dónde está roto.
